named_results.label: cls:classification
named_results.title: 算术分类的无限量词
named_results.statement: For unbiased Bernoulli convolutions on0<lambda<1,singularity equals membership in C;outside C is absolute continuity. limsup and liminf yield the same set.
named_results.conditions: One degree multiplier d fixed before every crowding j;all sufficientlylarge n may depend onj. One-sided[r-4^-n,r);finite target definitions are not a finite arbitrary-real decision procedure.
named_results.constants: R(n,d) degree dn height1 mod2irreducible algebraic units;distinct projection vectors;2^n/d orthants andj(2r)^n crowding.

named_results.label: cls:pure-type
named_results.title: 纯型及基本参数
named_results.statement: The invariant fair-bit law is pure singular or absolutely continuous;lambda<1/2 singular,lambda=1/2 uniform.
named_results.conditions: Independent fair bits,0<lambda<1. Bit law uniform[0,2] at1/2;signlaw uniform[-2,2]. Finite atomic truncations do not identify infinite measure type.

named_results.label: cls:compact-concentration
named_results.title: 紧集浓缩判据
named_results.statement: Singularity is equivalent to arbitrarily small Lebesgue-measure compact sets carrying arbitrarily near-total probability.
named_results.conditions: Requires actual infinite law;one finite histogram or empirical support is not such a certificate.

named_results.label: cls:first-bit-overlap
named_results.title: 首位分支的共同质量
named_results.statement: For lambda>1/2 the two first-bit subprobabilities have nonzero common submeasure.
named_results.conditions: Fair iid bits and full infinite observation;common mass not given as a computable constant. Does not assert independence of branches.
named_results.constants: Conditional entropy of bits given lambda^n quantization;log(2lambda)>0 contradiction.

named_results.label: cls:cross-pairs
named_results.title: 首位相反的近前缀
named_results.statement: For a singular parameter,positive fraction c of lengthn words with first bit0 each have Q(2lambda)^n opposite-first-bit neighbors for every fixedQ and large n.
named_results.conditions: a,c depend only onlambda;n threshold may depend onQ. Distinct neighbors/prefix directions rather than duplicate root multiplicity.

named_results.label: cls:finite-order
named_results.title: 一致有限阶非消失
named_results.statement: At fixedlambda,bounded-coefficient polynomials with constant-1 have sup on[lambda,lambda+x] at leastc0*x^M for smallx.
named_results.conditions: M,c0,x0 supplied by compactness/identity theorem,not an explicit numerical bound uniform overparameters.

named_results.label: cls:prescribed-prime
named_results.title: 保前缀的有限域不可约补全
named_results.statement: For fixedD>=2,d>2D and all large n,every F over F2 with degree<Dn and constant1 has a monic irreducible degree dn completion congruent toF+t^(Dn) modt^(Dn+1).
named_results.conditions: Threshold uniform inF;function-field RH input,not an integer-prime or finite runtime guarantee.

named_results.label: cls:realization
named_results.title: 单侧代数根实现
named_results.statement: A sufficiently small height1 prefix with constant-1 extends to a degree dn mod2-irreducible polynomial with real root just above lambda.
named_results.conditions: Fixedlambda,a,d>=d0;all large n uniformly overprefixes. Existence and finite enumeration do not give practical complexity or a stopping rule for classification.

named_results.label: cls:garsia
named_results.title: 经典Garsia参数
named_results.statement: Reciprocal of beta in(1,2) of absolute norm2 with all conjugates outside unit circle is outsideC and absolutely continuous.
named_results.conditions: Algebraic integer with all conjugates>1 inmodulus;not the norm1 Salem class. Source recovers an old result,not a new application.

named_results.label: cls:pisot
named_results.title: 经典Pisot参数
named_results.statement: Reciprocal Pisot beta in(1,2) gives singular signlaw and belongs toC.
named_results.conditions: All other conjugates strictly inside unitcircle;Fourier nondecay route cannot be transferred to non-Pisot Salem parameters.
named_results.constants: Two-sided logcos loss summable;nonzero infinite cosine product.

named_results.label: sal:main
named_results.title: 四次Salem倒数奇异性
named_results.statement: For every quartic Salem beta in(1,2),the unbiased convolution at1/beta is singular.
named_results.conditions: One nonreal unit-circle conjugate pair;not all Salemdegrees,not biased bits,not numerical finite-N detection. Source claimC,not a confirmed open-problem resolution.
named_results.constants: Multiplier/trace-window separation despite Fourier decay tozero.

named_results.label: sal:construction
named_results.title: 小共轭乘子与余弦底界
named_results.statement: There is a sequence of algebraic-unit multipliers with small unit-circle conjugates,controlled index growth and uniform positive cosine floor.
named_results.conditions: Constants and initial thresholds depend onbeta;irrational phase and one conjugate pair. Does not supply an efficient implementation.

named_results.label: sal:loss
named_results.title: 乘子增长与余弦损失分离
named_results.statement: Negative-power logcos loss S_m=o(L_m),and total loss up to n is <=2.01S_m+C*n*delta_m^2.
named_results.conditions: Uses fixed construction and cosine floor;not a finite risk bound with stated computableC.

named_results.label: sal:examples
named_results.title: 两个显式四次例子
named_results.statement: The roots>1 of x4-x3-x2-x+1 and x4-2x3+x2-2x+1 are quartic Salem numbers in(1,2),so their reciprocal convolutions are singular.
named_results.conditions: Exact algebraic roots,not decimal perturbations;uses quartic result.
named_results.constants: y=x+x^-1 reduces to y2-y-3 ory2-2y-1;conjugate discriminant test.

named_results.label: np:main
named_results.title: 31次非Pisot例子
named_results.statement: The specified degree31 polynomial has a real beta in(1.8392,1.8393),not Pisot,and the convolution at1/beta is singular.
named_results.conditions: Particular polynomial and fair iid bits. A finite arithmetic verifier is only part of the proof;no general non-Pisot classifier.

named_results.label: np:roots
named_results.title: 根圆盘与弱膨胀共轭
named_results.statement: All31 roots are simple;outside the unit circle lie beta and one nonreal pair alpha,alpha_bar;28 roots have modulus<.994.
named_results.conditions: Requires finite root-center comparisons plus analytic Rouche bound;irreducibility ofp is not assumed.

named_results.label: np:lattice
named_results.title: 全根坐标的31维格
named_results.statement: All word-evaluation vectors lie in a fixed full real31-dimensional lattice;normalized expanding and contracting coordinates lie in fixed boxes.
named_results.conditions: Uses all distinct roots of monicp,not an assumed minimal polynomial;one complex pair counts two realdimensions.

named_results.label: np:word-character
named_results.title: 反向词与双侧相位
named_results.statement: Characters of normalized word vectors equal centered products built from bilateral Laurent coefficients C0,C1.
named_results.conditions: Reverse order b_k=a_(N-1-k);fair iid stationary model separate from finite boundary effects.

named_results.label: np:moments
named_results.title: 预测器的三项矩界
named_results.statement: Explicit rational phase weights have total absolute weight<.199 and satisfy positive mean,small squared norm and anisotropy bounds.
named_results.conditions: Bounds in this stationary fair-bit phase model,not regression or forecasting accuracy. Finite products plus analytic infinite tails required.

named_results.label: np:damping-bounds
named_results.title: 近消去模式阻尼成本
named_results.statement: Admissible digit patterns in a21-site block have weighted costS*<.081 and controlled averaged damping.
named_results.conditions: Seven-state signed automaton;21active positions inperiod22;not arbitrary polynomial or noise model.

named_results.label: np:integral
named_results.title: 正乘积的有界积分
named_results.statement: The positive damped phase product integrates against a fixed bandlimited sinc-square weight no larger than the weight integral.
named_results.conditions: Fixed complex expanding coordinate;fast/slow frequency gap and exact polynomial relation;not generic data likelihood.

named_results.label: np:log-inequality
named_results.title: 带三阶余项的对数下界
named_results.conditions: This damped factor and restricted range only;not a global log-likelihood inequality.

named_results.label: np:typical-gain
named_results.title: 典型词上的渐近增益
named_results.statement: The logarithmic product on uniform lengthN words exceeds.000220N with probability tending toone.
named_results.conditions: First N->infinity at fixed truncationH,thenH->infinity;no explicit finite mixing rate or sample threshold.

named_results.label: np:thickening
named_results.title: 格点加厚的统一扰动
named_results.statement: Distinct lattice points admit disjoint fixed-radius balls;the total logproduct changes by at most a fixed constant under thickening.
named_results.conditions: rho andC independent ofN but not numerically supplied;all expanding coordinate normalization must remain.
